normalized.prelim_summary: This 2006 Cayman S has been transformed with a fully documented, warrantied 3.8L built motor and extensive suspension, brake, and cosmetic upgrades including a paint-to-sample respray. Minor interior wear and a cracked spoiler are noted, but overall this is a well-documented, highly built example for enthusiasts. Priced at $57,500 in Austin, TX with a clean title and no accidents on record.

evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this conflicts with the profile's preference for stock, California-legal Caymans and with the current cash-preservation strategy. Its appeal rests on an unproven engine build and a heavily modified, catless specification.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-confirmed 2006 Cayman S 6-speed whose odometer photo matches 68,000 miles, with a detailed itemised build and maintenance list. It discloses a claimed 3.8L rebuild with Darton steel sleeves, which would neutralise the M97 bore-scoring risk if proven. However, no invoice, build sheet, borescope or history report is attached. It also discloses catless headers and a custom tune, which make California smog infeasible as configured, plus a spoiler crack and interior wear. A full respray limits paint-based damage assessment. The DME over-rev report is missing, and AOS and coolant-pipe work are not mentioned. Asking is $57,500 against a mileage-adjusted fair value estimate of $25,341–$31,251. Tire claims conflict with the Kumho tires visible in some photos.
evidence.next_action: Email the seller requesting the SV Auto build invoice, DME over-rev report, respray details, confirmation of retained catted headers and stock tune, and whether a specialist PPI with borescope can be arranged before any deposit.
